title: Customer account holds the computer image at runtime
description:
**Principle follow-through, not the `chatticus-8fe4c7e1-2043-442d-bc48-5350e7995f32` patch.**

Epic `chatticus-598be488-151d-4e57-8897-5cf6aaed50e5` decided 2026-09-07: a customer organization's account holds everything that organization's work depends on at runtime — image, files, compute.

`infra/customer-role.yml` already grants the full ECR push set (`CreateRepository`, `PutImage`, `InitiateLayerUpload`, `UploadLayerPart`, `CompleteLayerUpload`, `SetRepositoryPolicy`). `chatticus-82dab7c4-a44c-4e0e-ac19-51a0c7a12d09`'s who-creates-what table said the `:dev` image lands in **that** ECR under the assumed role. `infra/lib/customer-computers-stack.ts` instead `fromRegistry(anthusComputerImageUri)`.

Do not start this until `chatticus-8fe4c7e1-2043-442d-bc48-5350e7995f32` has a host that runs — two customer-visible computer-stack changes at once will blur the labeled stop. Template edits stay customer-visible.

```
Feature: The customer computer pulls an image from the customer's ECR

  Scenario: RunTask does not depend on Anthus registry reachability
    Given a customer ChatticusComputers stack
    When a computer host starts
    Then the task definition image URI is in CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID
    And the published role's push permissions are used, not leftover
```
